properties.summary: Incident Type: AIRCRAFT - NRC Report ID: 1041645 - Medium Affected: SOIL - Suspected Responsible Party: UNITED STATES AIR FORCE
properties.content:
Report Details
NRC Report ID: 1041645
Incident Time: 2013-03-20 02:08:00
Nearest City: Minot, ND
Location: LATITUDE: 48.425152, LONGITUDE: -101.370118 5TH BOMB WING 201 SUMMIT DRIVE MINOT AIR FORCE BASE
Incident Type: AIRCRAFT
Material: JET FUEL: JP-8
Medium Affected: SOIL
Suspected Responsible Party: UNITED STATES AIR FORCE
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 48.425000, -101.370000 (Approximated from Explicit )
Reported Spill Volume: 500 gallons
Report Description
****WEB REPORT**** A B-52 BOMBER AIRCRAFT WAS TAXIING EAST ON TAXIWAY ECHO WHEN THE LEFT WING STRUCK A GOVERNMENT PANEL TRUCK THAT WAS PARKED ON THE TAXIWAY. THE OUTER MOST INTERNAL FUEL TANK OF THE LEFT WING RUPTURED SPILLING JP8 FUEL. BASE PERSONNEL THAT RESPONDED TO THE ACCIDENT AND FUEL SPILL WERE ABLE TO INITIALLY PLUG THE FUEL LEAK FROM THE WING. LATER, AS MAINTENANCE PERSONNEL WERE WORKING ON THE AIRCRAFT THE PLUG CAME LOOSE AND MORE JP8 FUEL SPILLED ONTO THE TAXIWAY. APPROXIMATELY 500 GALLONS OF JP8 FUEL WERE SPILLED ONTO THE PAVEMENT WHICH TRAVELED DOWN THE NORTH EDGE OF THE TAXIWAY FOR APPROXIMATELY 250 FEET. THE SPILL WAS APPROXIMATELY TEN FEET WIDE AND MOSTLY CONTAINED ON THE TAXIWAY BY A BERM OF SNOW ADJACENT TO THE TAXIWAY.
